editorial:
Imagine being a poor orphan kid who suddenly gets a huge pile of money from a secret stranger. That is exactly what happens to Pip, and it kicks off a wild ride from the slums to the high life. You get to meet Miss Havisham, a creepy lady who still wears her old wedding dress and lives in a decaying house. She basically trains her adopted daughter, Estella, to be a heartbreaker who treats Pip like dirt. The vibe is a mix of a fairy tale and a sad drama, making you wonder if money actually brings happiness or just more problems.

You will love the acting here because the emotions feel real and the sets look amazing. While the story moves a bit slow in the middle, the payoff is totally worth it. If you enjoy stories about class struggles and forbidden love, you should definitely give this a go. It looks great if you can find it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but renting it on Apple TV is a quick way to check it out. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the best way to see all the detail.
endingExplained: You find out that Pip's secret money actually came from Magwitch, a scary convict he helped years ago, not Miss Havisham. Magwitch wants Pip to be a gentleman to prove him wrong. In the end, Magwitch dies, and Pip loses his wealth. He finally realizes that Estella was the wrong person to chase. After years apart, he and Estella meet again as changed people, suggesting they might finally find a way to be together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old-school romance and stories about rags to riches.
